wet, snowy, un-road-like roads. QX80. Travel
first class. No matter the destination.

exterior design
BOLD IN DESIGN.
UNMISTAKABLE
IN PRESENCE
Much more than its full-size stature, the QX80 expresses
confidence in the clarity of its lines and the sculpting of
its curves. It is an invitation to live audaciously.
IMPRESSION AMPLIFIED Expressing signature INFINITI design, the double-arch
grille is prominently placed front and center. The arc of the bottom, like a natural
reflection to that of the top, gives the front fascia a distinctive appearance.
EXPRESSIVE ILLUMINATION Stylish and functional, the LED headlights of the
QX80 shed light where you steer1 and also provide another level of awareness
with signature LED daytime running lights.
ATHLETIC STANCE Large 22-inch forged aluminum-alloy wheels1 not only
complement the epic proportions of the QX80, they are designed to make handling
more responsive. The lightweight construction inherently reduces unsprung weight
and helps contribute to quicker turn-ins.
FUNCTIONALLY SEDUCTIVE Zero-lift aerodynamics help keep your QX80
balanced while in motion, helping maintain exceptional stability at speed and
an intimate connection with the road.

A HIGHER
DISTINCTION
Be drawn into the striking presence of the
QX80 Limited. By adding an even higher level of
craftsmanship, it takes the QX80 to new heights
of style and comfort.

rewarded with leather treatments on the steering wheel, grab
handles and speaker grille trim. Truffle Brown leather-appointed
seats are also tailored with unique silver contrast stitching and
piping that highlights the distinctive quilting of the seats.
INVITING DETAILS Be welcomed by the glow of the lighting
under the running board. While inside, the distinct Open Pore
Matte Finish Ash Wood trim raises the level of sophistication.
Take it all in, then look above and feel the added touch of
elegance of the ultrasuede headliner.
EXCLUSIVE COLORS In addition to the Hermosa Blue, Majestic
White, Mocha Almond and Black Obsidian, the QX80 Limited
offers two exclusive paint colors—a dramatic Imperial Black and
a rich Dakar Bronze.
DARK ACCENTS Appointed with 22-inch dark chrome finish wheels
and complemented with dark chrome accents throughout, the
elusive demeanor of the QX80 Limited follows you wherever
you go. The darkened headlight and taillight lenses underscore
the refined aesthetic.
